title: Transportation Supervisor
description: Supervise sales teams, prepare reports, and coordinate daily transportation and logistics sales operations.

title: Logistics  Sales Supervisor
description: Assign duties, supervise logistics sales staff, and prepare sales and service performance reports.

title: Logistics Coordinator
description: Coordinate shipments, schedule freight, track deliveries, and maintain communication with drivers and clients.

title: Truck Dispatcher
description: Assign loads to drivers, plan routes, monitor real-time tracking, and resolve delivery-related issues.

title: Logistics Sales Executive
description: Generate leads, pitch logistics services, build client portfolios, and support business development activities.
